title: Portal/Launch Deployment and Warp Transition
description:
Purpose: Handle stepping into portal gate, preflight checks, countdown, warp tunnel load to mission scene, and cancel with B (Right).

Behaviour:
- Activation: In launch_platform scene, entering a trigger volume around portal_gate_prop starts a 2.5s countdown. Display ring HUD countdown and ambient VFX from skybox_space_nebula_fx.
- Cancel: B (Right) during countdown cancels and returns to idle state.
- Transition: On countdown complete, fade to emerald warp tunnel (<= 6s), asynchronously load target mission scene, then fade in.
- Alternate start: If player lifts off in flight_mode_mechanic within the launch area and hovers at a designated altitude trigger, show same countdown and permit deploy.

Quest 3 bindings (params_json):
- params.value("cancel_button", "B_right")
- params.value("countdown_s", 2.5)

Components read/write:
- Uses builtin.trigger_zone around portal_gate_prop to detect entry; reads CMechanicBinding for cancel.
- Writes CSceneTransitionRequest{ target_scene_id, warp_fx:true }.

Acceptance hooks:
- test_portal_launch: Enter portal, see warp VFX and smooth load; B cancels pre-warp.

Assets/scenes: launch_platform, destination mission scenes; assets portal_gate_prop, skybox_space_nebula_fx.
